description: Framework layer for lora-training — ships train.py (TRL SFTTrainer + PEFT + bitsandbytes) and infer.py (base + adapter). QLoRA 4-bit fine-tunes a 7B-8B model on a single 24 GB GPU; adapter checkpoints are 10-500 MB instead of 14+ GB for a merged model.

buildHints.whenToUse: Pick this when you need custom model behaviour (domain language, instruction style, task-specific format) but cannot or will not run full fine-tuning. QLoRA 4-bit lets a 7B-8B model tune on a single 24 GB GPU; 70B on a single 80 GB GPU. For pure inference without training, use vllm-server or ollama-server. For RAG-style grounding without training, use rag-pipeline-py.
firstSteps: pip install -e .  — installs peft, transformers, bitsandbytes, trl>=0.12, accelerate, datasets
Replace data/sample.jsonl with your real training set (each line: {"messages": [{"role": ..., "content": ...}, ...]})
Edit config/train.yaml — set base_model_id, lora_r/alpha, epochs, learning_rate, and target_modules for your architecture
Set HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN in .env for gated base models (Llama, Mistral, Gemma)
python train.py --config config/train.yaml  — checkpoints land in training.output_dir
gotchas: bitsandbytes 4-bit requires CUDA. There is no working CPU path for QLoRA — on a Mac it silently falls back to fp16 and OOMs.

LoRA target_modules is model-architecture-specific. Llama/Mistral use ['q_proj','k_proj','v_proj','o_proj','gate_proj','up_proj','down_proj']; Gemma and Phi differ. The wrong list means training runs but the adapter learns nothing.
lora_r above 64 stops helping and starts overfitting. Keep lora_alpha = 2 * lora_r (the standard ratio) so the effective learning rate stays stable across rank changes.
Checkpoint sizes: LoRA adapters are 10-500 MB; fully merged models are 14-30 GB. Commit the adapter directory only — never commit merged weights.
Gated base models need HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN *and* licence acceptance on the Hub — the token alone returns 403.
TRL SFTTrainer expects either a `text` column or a `messages` column. Mixing schemas in one file silently trains on the wrong field.
flash-attention-2 requires torch >= 2.1 and SM >= 8.0 GPU (A100/H100). On older GPUs set attn_implementation: 'sdpa' in config/train.yaml.
architectureNotes: train.py is config-driven: all hyperparameters live in config/train.yaml; the script itself requires no edits for most runs.
infer.py reads the base model id from adapter_config.json (written by PEFT at save time), then falls back to config/train.yaml — no hardcoded model paths.
The formatting pipeline in train.py auto-detects whether the dataset has a 'messages' column (applies chat template) or a 'text' column (passes raw text to SFTTrainer).

placeholders.description: Replace with the real training set. Each line must be valid JSON with a 'messages' array (or a 'text' string for raw-text SFT).
Set base_model_id to your chosen base model, tune lora_r/lora_alpha, set target_modules for your architecture, and adjust epochs/learning_rate.
Add HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN=hf_... for gated base models (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma). Leave empty for open models.
